features.text: NEURO-INHIBITING EXTENSION SYSTEM: Applies dynamic, gentle stretching to reduce knee contractures caused by spasticity.
THERAPEUTIC ALIGNMENT: Promotes proper knee positioning to restore mobility and range of motion.
FLEXIBLE COMFORT DESIGN: Adaptable uprights accommodate involuntary tone for comfortable, extended wear.
PRECISE HINGE ADJUSTMENT: Single-setting hinges enable targeted tension adjustments for progressive therapy.
VERSATILE REHABILITATION SUPPORT: Ideal for post-stroke recovery, muscle spasticity, and joint contracture treatment.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.

indications: Knee contractures for patients with spasticity
